app/static/style.css — the stylesheet

Purpose

The single self-contained stylesheet for the UI: the design tokens (custom properties on :root), the page layout, and the class styles for every region app.js drives. No web fonts, no CDN, no external references of any kind — the app's no-CDN constraint applies to CSS as firmly as to JS.

Public surface

Design tokens: --bg, --panel, --text, --muted, --accent, --accent-dark, --error-*, --border. Class/element contract with index.html / app.js: .container (the single 760px column), .header / .header-row, .row, .url-input, .btn / .btn-quiet, .spinner, .error-banner, .result-*, .video-title, .video-language, .transcript-panel, .provider-picker, .auto-summarize-label (the checkbox label; dims with the input's :disabled via :has()), .auto-note (the muted auto-summarize failure note), .summary-*, .saved-* (.saved-row is the button-styled list item), .model-management-* (the section, list container, and empty state), .model-provider-* (the button-styled row: name, count, manage), .model-panel* (the manage panel and its labeled groups), .model-add-* (the manual-add form), .model-list* (the model rows; .model-list-id is the monospace id text), .model-item-btn* (the small row buttons; -remove gets the error-color treatment), .log-panel.

Invariants

  • Self-contained. No @import, no web fonts, no external URLs; the font stacks are the system stack for text and ui-monospace/Menlo/Consolas for the log panel and transcript pre blocks.
  • [hidden] { display: none !important; } is load-bearing. It keeps the hidden attribute authoritative even for styled elements (buttons and panels with display rules), so app.js's visibility contract can never be silently defeated by a class.
  • The header is a column of rows (flex-direction: column, align-items: stretch): titles + toggle in the first row (.header-row, space-between), the log panel as the second row. Spacing between rows comes from the column's gap, not from the panel's margin-top — the panel sits close beneath the toggle when opened and contributes no height when hidden.
  • Every long region scrolls internally with a bounded height: the transcript panel max-height: 60vh, the summary text and saved list 40vh, the log panel 40vh, the model lists (added/discovered/config) 30vh — opening any of them never grows the page without bound.
  • Buttons are keyboard- and state-honest: .btn:disabled dims and forbids; .saved-row keeps :focus-visible outlines; hover states apply only to :not(:disabled).
  • Long content wraps, never overflows: overflow-wrap: anywhere on titles, transcript, saved names, provider names, model ids, and the log panel.

Log events emitted

None (markup-adjacent styles only).

Error codes raised/handled

None.

Design decisions

Resolved from the archived change design docs:

  • 2026-10-29-youtube-transcript D6 — the no-build, no-CDN front-end constraint this file obeys.
  • 2026-11-02-add-saved-transcript-list decision 6 — the saved section's treatment: bounded scrollable <ul> matching the existing .transcript-panel treatment, button-styled rows, the cosmetic text-transform: capitalize on .saved-name (accepted trade-off: acronym-like words are lowercased cosmetically; the real name is always what is requested and downloaded).
  • 2026-11-06-move-log-panel-into-header D2/D3 — the column-of-rows header (align-items: stretch so rows span the full width) and the row-gap spacing that replaced the old .log-panel { margin: 32px 0 0; }.
  • add-summarization-model-management D7 — the model-management section's treatment: button-styled provider rows on the same border/ hover/focus recipe as .saved-row, the manage panel as a recessed (--bg) group of labeled lists, monospace model ids, and the error-colored Remove button.
